text.en:
Subsection two of section one of Act Numbered Nine hundred and fifty-four is hereby amended to
read as follows:
"(2) The municipality of Sogod Sur hereafter shall be known as Sogod, and shall consist of its present
territory and that of the municipality of Sogod Norto, with the seat of municipal government at the barrio of
Consolacion lying between Sogod Sur and Sogod Norte."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 17, 1906.
